description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
 
 We are seeking a motivated Junior Software Engineer 1 to join our software development team. In this entry-level role, you will help design, build, test, document, and support software solutions across web, desktop, and client-server platforms. You will work closely with senior engineers, business analysts, QA, project managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable technology solutions while continuing to grow your technical, business, and collaboration skills.
 
As a Junior Software Engineer 1, you will contribute to software development assignments under moderate supervision. You will write and test code, analyze existing systems, assist with design deliverables, support troubleshooting, and communicate progress clearly. This role is ideal for someone with foundational software development experience who is eager to learn, collaborate, and deliver high-quality solutions in a team-oriented environment.
 
Responsibilities:
· Develop, test, and implement software solutions that follow established development standards and best practices.
· Participate in the software development life cycle, including requirements review, design, construction, unit testing, documentation, and implementation support.
· Analyze business and non-functional requirements and help translate them into clear, practical design deliverables.
· Build reusable, extendable, and maintainable systems and components using available technologies.
· Assist with troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving moderately complex software issues within the scope of the role.
· Collaborate with business analysts, QA, technical leads, project managers, and business contacts to support testing, planning, estimation, project status updates, and issue resolution.
· Communicate project deliverables, risks, questions, and status updates in a timely, professional, and easy-to-understand manner.
· Escalate issues to the team lead or project manager when needed and help keep project resources focused and effective.
· Produce technical documentation that aligns with team and development standards.
· Continue building technical, business, and interpersonal skills through hands-on development work, feedback, and collaboration.
 
Required Qualifications:
 
Education and Experience:
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 
Technical Skills:
· Foundational knowledge of one or more programming languages or technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, C#, .NET, ASP.NET, SQL, XML, or related web development tools.
· Typically 0–3 years of software development experience, including internships, academic projects, bootcamp projects, or related professional experience.
· Familiarity with web, desktop, client-server, Windows, SharePoint, or database-backed applications.
· Basic understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle and common development practices such as code reviews, unit testing, debugging, and documentation.
 
Preferred Qualifications:
· Strong attention to detail and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code.
· Good problem-solving skills and willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and improve over time.
· Experience with version control, Agile development practices, or collaborative software delivery tools.
· Interest in accounting, professional services, business applications, or enterprise software solutions.
 
 
 At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people.  We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients.  Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/working-at-rsm/benefits     https://rsmus.com/careers/el-salvador.html .
